Use case: stylized-concept. One original MONSTER BOSS game sprite for dark fantasy tower defense, designed as an idle source image for later PixelLab animation.
Square canvas. Genuine transparent alpha background. Complete body and all extremities visible, centered with wide clear margins. Slight three-quarter TOP-DOWN tactical view facing RIGHT; see front and near side, not frontal portrait or flat side view. Crisp detailed hand-painted fantasy RPG rendering, strong chunky silhouette, rich controlled colors, dimensional natural materials, warm upper-left light with selective dramatic rim highlights. Not pixel art. Readable when reduced to 256x256 and displayed at 96px.
ANIMATION-FRIENDLY: relaxed alert neutral idle pose, weight supported plausibly, clearly separated limbs/body sections, clear visible joints, no crossing appendages or impossible intersections. Preserve transparent negative space between moving parts. No motion blur, attack pose, action streaks, floating particles, smoke, aura, baked glow cloud, ground, ground shadow, rocks underfoot, scenery, text, borders, UI, watermark or sprite sheet. A single coherent movable creature, not a statue or decorative illustration.
Subject: LERNA, THE ROOT-MAW. One huge low-slung four-legged swamp reptile with EXACTLY THREE distinct serpent necks and three crocodilian heads connected separately to the same solid torso. Three necks form a compact staggered fan, visible transparent gaps between them, all three heads turned toward the right. Central head largest, other heads offset slightly up and down, mouths mostly closed with a few visible teeth, no breath effect. Each head has short bone-colored cheek spurs and small amber eyes. Four sturdy short reptilian legs, each visibly attaches to its correct hip or shoulder, feet staggered so four feet can be seen; no extra limbs. Thick tail curves loosely left behind torso without wrapping around legs. Deep moss-green scales, peat-black back, pale bone underside, root-like ridges integrated into skin, amber eyes and subtle yellow-green throat markings. Alive and ready to walk, not rooted to the ground. No wings, humanoid parts, vines connecting limbs, disconnected heads, gore, eggs or minions.
